home_eyebrow: A field guide for bioinformaticians · from first principles to open problems
home_intro: This guide walks from the chemistry of DNA to the algorithms that turn sequencers, mass spectrometers and microscopes into biological knowledge. For each omics layer it explains what is measured, why it matters, how the data are processed, which tools do each step, what independent benchmarks found, and which questions are still open.
author_line: Toronto Metropolitan University · The Hospital for Sick Children (SickKids) · Toronto, Canada
seo_description: A free guide to omics: central dogma, splicing, mutations, genomics, epigenomics, transcriptomics, single-cell, proteomics, metabolomics, lipidomics, microbiome, multi-omics integration, tools, benchmarks and research gaps.
